subject: PICTURE clause
notes: Extended 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB491): GR14's 'es' entry now has a site of its own, EditingPositions, beside the 'cs' entry's currencyExtra. Both are the SAME remainder over CharacterPositions' one-per-symbol count, so the two variable-width symbols are sized by one shape: 'es' counts literal-1's size at EVERY occurrence of a simple- or fixed-insertion character-1 and, for floating insertion, 'one occurrence of literal-2 or literal-3 ... plus one character for each repetition of character-1'. MEASURED against Annex D.24's stated arithmetic (PIC LLLL9,88 with "DEBIT " = 13 characters: 6 for the first L, 3 for the next three, 4 for the numbers) and against the alphanumeric-edited IS form (PIC XXTXX EDITING T IS "::" = 6). The ExpandCurrency code-location this row carried is gone; the currency half of the same rule is now Materialize.
